alt: A compact home library viewed from a curved plaster threshold, shown in four distinct material schemes: moss green limewash walls with pale marble desktop and ash shelving; pale marble walls with chestnut shelving, herringbone floor and moss green textile; chestnut-brown walls with pale marble desktop and chestnut herringbone floor; pale cool marble walls with moss green painted desktop and chestnut floorboards. Brushed nickel hardware throughout.
text:
a threshold changes everything.

this library is compact but reads as room, not corners. the curved entrance, the marble desktop, the limewash walls—the architecture and materials command it. size is the least of it.
